rows.response_text: To eat a sweet baked potato, first split the baked sweet potatoes in half while they are still hot. Then, whip butter until fluffy and slowly pour in 1/2 cup of real maple syrup, while continuously whisking. Stir in 1/4 cup of chopped pecans into the mixture. Finally, pour this sweet butter and pecan mixture over the split sweet potatoes and enjoy.
rows.source_text:
